about_the_game:
Description

The Delivery Up OST is an urban groove about moving upward: synths, rhythm, and smooth beats. The music was created as Gameplay BGM: it keeps the pace without distracting you-great for both playing and working.

Why buy

Purchasing the soundtrack is the best way to support the developer; OST revenue will help us create new, higher-quality, and more engaging games.

What’s inside

  • 16 tracks: 11 × Gameplay BGM (instrumental), 1 × Final (instrumental), 4 × Bonus (vocal, rap/EN).

  • Two versions: standard quality (MP3) + optional Hi-Q package (WAV).

  • Tracks are numbered to ensure the correct order in players.
